reason: I'd grab the free tricks and probably show my kids one or two of them, but I don't pay for apps. 99 shekels for something I'd use a handful of times isn't happening, and I'm not typing my card into some site that isn't in the App Store.
objection: I'm not a magician. I'll mess up the setup in front of the family and look silly, and then I've paid 99 for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks actually worked on my kids and friends without me fumbling, and someone in my WhatsApp group vouched for it, I might pay a much lower price, something around 30.
